## Syncora v0.1.0

The first offline-first Android build of Syncora.

- Host a local audio file and stream it over the same Wi-Fi or a personal hotspot.
- Discover nearby rooms or join using a room ID / local IP.
- Keep multiple phones close to the host's playback position with shared play/pause controls.
- Dark minimal interface, Syncora launcher icon, and local playback notification.

Install `Syncora-v0.1.0-debug.apk` on Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer. Both devices should be on the same Wi-Fi network or personal hotspot. No internet connection is used by the listening session.
